card.name: Start of simultaneous and concomitant
card.fires_on: The first piece of a word meaning 'at the same time', such as Sim|ultaneous or con|comitantly, in drug-interaction text. It fires just before the rest of the word is spelled out.

modes.label: Sim before ultaneous
modes.description: The opening piece of 'Simultaneous' or the 'im' inside 'non-simultaneously'.
modes.example: 7.3 Immunological Preparations<< Sim>>ultaneous administration of ACTIMMUNE

modes.label: con before comitantly
modes.example: treated<< con>>comitantly with an ACE inhibitor.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward completing words meaning 'simultaneous' or 'simultaneously'.
card.plain: It fires at the start of 'simultaneous' or 'concomitantly', the words for drugs given together.
